items.description: Public Standard challenger lab completed: 1,243 decided original forecasts; 50.04% champion and 50.36% distribution challenger. Separate shot-attempt subset 191, not qualified. No model promotion.
Public chronological stats-only replay completed; no original-line hit rate.
89 candidate identities of 135 previously unresolved records; 46 remain unresolved. Original cohort counts reproduced; exact row-level equivalence and model qualification remain unapproved.
834 complete maps, 29 dates. Map context tested on 102 matched observations per market; improved kills, deaths and headshots, worsened assists. Broader history needed.
73,950 player-map rows; map-conditioned test on 11,857 matched observations per market improved all three statistical errors.
200,040 historical player-game records; champion-conditioned test on 24,992 matched observations per market improved kills, deaths and assists error.
3,000 professional matches, 156 dates. Hero-conditioned historical error improved on 3,135 matched observations per market.
Modern 2025 CDL sample: 125 complete maps, 9 dates; 1,000 player-map rows. 205 matched holdout observations per market; source refused further pages. Older 6,030-row 2019 baseline separate.
